fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: snook in Blind/Stump passes; beach mix of reds, snook, pompano, whiting, black drum and Spanish; live white bait or shrimp. LEMON BAY: redfish plus snook, trout, black drum; Bull/Turtle Bay reds. NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper, some cobia/gag 40–50 ft, yellowtail on wrecks; tarpon still showing. Baits: live shrimp, white bait, cut bait, soft plastics.
redtide: FWC (Sep 18; next report due today): K. brevis background in one Sarasota sample past week; no fish kills or respiratory irritation.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (Healthy Beaches; Charlotte and Sarasota gulf beaches Good as of 9/24).
fpl: Charlotte 0 / Sarasota ~6–16 minor outages (FPL tracker early 9/25).
